dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Identified three primary high-contrast light-toned 'O' and '8' shaped structures on the upper-right lateral flank. The most dorsal is a closed oval with a sharp light perimeter transition into a darker interior. Below it is a complex, interlocking figure-eight structure with a defined light-intensity boundary and darker core centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of smaller, asymmetrical light-pigmented pixel clusters located ventrally and anteriorly to the macro-annuli. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as localized concentrations of high-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli structures form an obtuse, scalene triangle with the primary axis oriented longitudinally along the seal's flank.
